Name: Reimagined Kristoff Sprite - Downtown Zuzu
Author: DEADRAKE
Description:
hiiiiiiiiii this is totally a personal preference thing and im just releasing it if someone else wants to give it a go. my game is kind of desaturated so the sprite is too, if you'd like to play with that its as easy as opening whatever base photo editor you have and upping the saturation to your liking, just save it under the same name.

to install just download the file and drag and drop it into Downtown-Zuzu-main > [CP] Downtown Zuzu > npc > OverworldSprites

I personally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's portrait mod.[/url]

Downloads.Description: again just plug into the folder i mentioned in the desc and ur good to go
